derivation: ((by simpa only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc] using List.perm_append_comm_assoc (nBlock s t u) (pBlock s t u ++ mBlock s t u) [])).trans (List.perm_append_comm_assoc (pBlock s t u) (mBlock s t u) (nBlock s t u))
explanation: The core lemma swaps the first two lists while keeping a third fixed. Applying it first with the empty list and a composite middle block, then again to the middle and final blocks, gives the stated permutation after reassociating append.
